fields.ideal_transverse_calibration_source_note: Ideal vacuum closed-coil current calibration at original native field-reference planes; commands in percent, matrix in A/percent, reference energy 300000 eV. Full cross-station field response is included. Fixed N and pack envelopes retained. No magnetic-core/pole response, field-integral/shape equivalence, focus adjustment, thermal rating or experimental calibration is inferred. Current matrix remains fixed after beam-energy or geometry edits; re-calibration is explicit.
